array: An array is an ordered collection of items; in computing, it is a data structure with indexed elements.
array 指按一定方式排列的一组事物；计算机中指带索引元素的数组。
arrow: An arrow is a pointed object shot from a bow, or a symbol indicating direction.
arrow 指弓箭，也可指表示方向的箭头符号。
assistance: Assistance is help or support given to someone.
assistance 指向他人提供的帮助或支持。
atom: An atom is the smallest unit of a chemical element that retains its chemical identity.
atom 指保留化学元素性质的最小单位，即原子。
bang: A bang is a sudden loud noise; to bang is to hit or close something noisily.
bang 指突然的巨响；作动词指砰地撞击或关上。
barn: A barn is a farm building used to store crops, equipment, or sometimes animals.
barn 指农场中储存农作物、设备或饲养牲畜的建筑。
basic: Basic means forming a necessary foundation or being simple rather than advanced.
basic 指基础的、必需的，或比较简单、初级的。
basin: A basin is a wide container for holding water, or a low area of land.
basin 指盛水的盆，也可指地形上的盆地。
bathe: To bathe is to wash yourself or another person, often in water.
bathe 指在水中洗澡、沐浴，或为别人清洗身体。
bean: A bean is an edible seed from certain plants, often eaten as food.
bean 指某些植物可食用的豆粒。
beef: Beef is meat from cattle; informally, a beef can be a complaint.
beef 指牛肉；口语中也可指抱怨或纠纷。
bell: A bell is a hollow object that makes a ringing sound when struck.
bell 指受敲击后发出铃声的钟或铃。
belt: A belt is a flexible strip worn around the waist or used to drive machinery.
belt 指腰带；也可指机械中传动用的带子。
bench: A bench is a long seat for two or more people.
bench 指可供两人或多人坐的长椅。
bite: To bite is to grip or cut something with the teeth.
bite 指用牙齿咬住或咬断某物。
blade: A blade is the sharp cutting part of a knife, tool, or machine.
blade 指刀具或机械上锋利的刃片。
blank: Blank means empty, with nothing written, drawn, or displayed.
blank 指空白的，没有写字、图画或显示内容的。
blast: A blast is an explosion, powerful gust, or sudden loud sound.
blast 指爆炸、强风或突然的巨响。
bleed: To bleed is to lose blood from the body through an injury.
bliss: Bliss is a state of intense happiness or contentment.
bliss 指极大的幸福感或满足感。
bloom: To bloom is to produce flowers; a bloom is a flower or flowering.
bloom 作动词指开花；作名词指花朵或开花状态。
blush: To blush is to turn red in the face, often from embarrassment.
blush 指通常因害羞或尴尬而脸红。
bolt: A bolt is a metal fastener or a sudden dash; to bolt can mean to run away quickly.
bolt 指金属螺栓，也可指突然冲出去；作动词可指飞快逃离。
bone: A bone is a hard part of the skeleton that supports and protects the body.
bone 指支撑和保护身体的骨骼组成部分。
boom: A boom is a deep loud sound or a period of rapid growth.
boom 指低沉巨响；也可指迅速增长或繁荣时期。
boss: A boss is someone who directs or supervises other people at work.
boss 指工作中负责管理、指挥他人的上司。
brace: A brace is a support that holds something in place or strengthens it.
brace 指支撑、固定某物的支架或支具。
brass: Brass is an alloy made mainly of copper and zinc.
brass 指主要由铜和锌组成的合金“黄铜”。
brick: A brick is a rectangular block used in building walls and structures.
brick 指砌墙或建造结构所用的长方形砖块。
bride: A bride is a woman who is getting married or has just married.
bride 指正在结婚或刚结婚的新娘。
brisk: Brisk describes quick, energetic movement or a pleasantly cool atmosphere.
brisk 指动作轻快有活力，也可形容天气清凉。
brood: To brood is to worry about something for a long time; a brood is also a group of young birds.
brood 作动词指长时间忧虑；作名词也指一窝幼鸟。
brook: A brook is a small natural stream of water.
bulk: Bulk is the large size or main mass of something.
bulk 指庞大的体积，或某事物的主要部分。
bunch: A bunch is a group of things gathered or growing together.
bunch 指聚集或成束的一组物品。
bush: A bush is a low woody plant with many stems.
bush 指多枝、较低矮的灌木。
cable: A cable is a thick wire or group of wires carrying electricity or information.
cable 指输送电力或信息的电缆，也可指粗绳索。
cake: A cake is a sweet baked food, often eaten at celebrations.
cake 指通常在庆祝活动中食用的烘焙甜点“蛋糕”。
camel: A camel is a large desert animal with one or two humps.
camel 指背上有一至两个驼峰的沙漠动物“骆驼”。
canal: A canal is an artificial waterway built for transport or irrigation.
canal 指为运输或灌溉修建的人工水道“运河、渠道”。
candidate: A candidate is someone considered for a job, position, or election.
candidate 指职位、选举等事项的候选人。
canon: A canon is an accepted collection of works or a set of authoritative rules.
canon 指公认的经典作品集合，或具有权威性的规则体系。
cargo: Cargo is goods transported by ship, plane, train, or truck.
cargo 指由轮船、飞机、火车或卡车运输的货物。
cart: A cart is a small wheeled vehicle used to carry goods.
cart 指用于运送货物的小型有轮车辆。
carve: To carve is to cut a shape or design into wood, stone, or another material.
carve 指在木材、石头等材料上雕刻形状或图案。
cash: Cash is money in the form of notes and coins, rather than electronic payment.
cash 指纸币和硬币形式的现金，而非电子支付。
chant: A chant is a repeated phrase or song, often spoken or sung rhythmically.
chant 指有节奏地重复念诵的词句或歌声。
charity: Charity is organized help for people in need, or generosity toward others.
charity 指对有需要者的慈善援助，也可指仁爱之心。
chase: To chase someone or something is to run or follow after them to catch them.
chase 指追逐某人或某物，试图赶上或抓住。
chat: To chat is to have an informal, friendly conversation.
chat 指轻松、非正式地聊天。
cheat: To cheat is to act dishonestly to gain an unfair advantage.
cheat 指通过不诚实手段获得不公平的优势，即作弊或欺骗。
chip: A chip is a small broken piece of material; in electronics it is a tiny circuit device.
chip 指碎屑、小片；电子技术中指芯片。
choir: A choir is an organized group of people who sing together.
choir 指一起演唱的合唱团。
choke: To choke is to have difficulty breathing because the airway is blocked.
choke 指因气道受阻而窒息、无法正常呼吸。
chop: To chop is to cut food, wood, or another material into pieces with repeated blows.
chop 指连续用力砍、剁，把材料切成块。
clap: To clap is to strike your hands together to make a sound or show approval.
clap 指拍手发出声音，常用来表示赞许。
click: A click is a short sharp sound; to click can mean selecting something with a mouse.
click 指短促的咔哒声；作动词也指鼠标点击。
clip: A clip is a small fastener or a short section of audio or video.
clip 指夹子或卡扣，也可指短视频、音频片段。
cloak: A cloak is a loose outer garment; figuratively, it can be something that hides the truth.
cloak 指宽松的斗篷；比喻用法指掩盖真相的事物。
coal: Coal is a black fossil fuel formed from ancient plant material.
coal 指由古代植物遗骸形成的黑色化石燃料“煤”。
code: Code is a system of symbols or rules; in computing, it means computer instructions.
code 指编码体系或规则；计算机中指程序代码。
coil: A coil is wire or another material wound in loops or spirals.
coil 指线材等盘绕成的线圈或螺旋形结构。
coin: A coin is a small piece of money made of metal; to coin a phrase is to invent it.
coin 指金属硬币；作动词还可指创造新的词语或说法。
cord: A cord is a thin, flexible rope or insulated electrical wire.
cord 指细绳，也可指绝缘电线。
couch: A couch is a long upholstered seat, similar to a sofa.
couch 指带软垫、可供多人坐的长沙发。
cough: A cough is a sudden push of air from the lungs to clear the throat or airways.
cough 指为清理喉咙或气道而突然用力呼气的咳嗽。
cower: To cower is to bend down or shrink back because of fear.
cower 指因恐惧而蜷缩、畏缩。
crave: To crave something is to want it very strongly.
crave 指强烈渴望得到某物。
crawl: To crawl is to move on hands and knees or to move very slowly.
crawl 指手膝着地爬行，也可指缓慢移动。
cream: Cream is the rich fatty part of milk; it can also describe a soft, pale color.
cream 指奶油、乳脂，也可指浅奶油色。
creed: A creed is a set of fundamental beliefs shared by a person or group.
creed 指个人或群体所信奉的基本信条。
crest: A crest is the top of a hill or wave, or an emblem representing a family or organization.
crest 指山顶、浪尖，也可指家族或组织的徽章。
criminal: A criminal is a person who has committed a crime; criminal also describes unlawful acts.
criminal 指罪犯；作形容词指犯罪的、违法的。
crude: Crude means unrefined, roughly made, or lacking sophistication.
crude 指未经精炼的、制作粗糙的，或缺少细致考虑的。
curl: To curl is to bend or form into a spiral or rounded shape.
curl 指卷曲、蜷起，形成螺旋或弯曲形状。
cycle: A cycle is a sequence of events that repeats in a regular pattern.
cycle 指按照一定模式重复发生的一轮过程或周期。
damp: Damp means slightly wet, often in an unpleasant way.
damp 指略微潮湿的，常带不舒适之意。
dart: A dart is a small pointed missile; to dart is to move suddenly and quickly.
dart 指尖头飞镖；作动词指突然快速地移动。
data: Data is information collected for analysis, often in numbers or records.
data 指为分析而收集的信息，通常表现为数值或记录。
dated: Dated means showing that something belongs to an earlier time or looks old-fashioned.
dated 指明显属于较早时期、显得过时的。
deaf: Deaf describes someone with little or no ability to hear.
deaf 指听力很弱或无法听见的。
defy: To defy something is to resist it openly or refuse to obey it.
defy 指公然违抗、拒绝遵从某项要求。
deity: A deity is a god or goddess worshipped in a religion.
deity 指宗教中受到崇拜的神灵。
departure: A departure is the act of leaving a place, or a change from an established practice.
departure 指离开某地，也可指偏离原有做法。
digit: A digit is one of the numerals 0–9; it can also mean a finger or toe.
digit 指 0–9 中的数字；也可指手指或脚趾。
abound: If something abounds, there is a great deal of it in a particular place or situation.
abound 表示某处或某种情况下某物大量存在；常用 abound in 或 abound with。
accredited: An accredited institution has been officially recognized as meeting required standards.
accredited 指机构经过正式认证，达到规定标准。
aspiration: An aspiration is a strong hope or ambition to achieve something.
aspiration 指强烈的愿望、志向或抱负。
asymmetrical: Something asymmetrical has two sides or parts that are not mirror images of each other.
asymmetrical 指两侧或各部分不呈镜像对称。
backdrop: A backdrop is the background or setting against which an event occurs.
backdrop 指事件发生时的背景、环境或衬托因素。
bipartisan: A bipartisan proposal has support from two major political parties.
bipartisan 指获得两个主要政党共同支持的，具体取决于政治制度。
bleak: A bleak situation offers little hope; bleak weather is cold and unwelcoming.
bleak 既可形容前景黯淡、希望渺茫，也可形容天气阴冷荒凉。
caliber: The caliber of a person or piece of work is its level of ability or quality.
caliber 指人或工作的能力水平、质量档次。
candidacy: Candidacy is the state of being a candidate for a position or election.
candidacy 指作为职位或选举候选人的身份或参选资格。
cardinal: A cardinal principle or rule is one of the most important and fundamental.
cardinal 形容原则或规则时，表示最重要的、根本性的。
categorical: A categorical statement is definite and makes no allowance for exceptions or qualifications.
categorical 指说法斩钉截铁、不留余地，并非表示一定正确。
complacency: Complacency is excessive satisfaction with a situation that leads someone to ignore problems.
complacency 指过于自满而忽视问题或风险的状态。
conducive: Conditions conducive to something make it easier or more likely to happen.
conducive 表示有利于某事发生，常用 be conducive to。
conscientious: A conscientious person works carefully and takes responsibilities seriously.
conscientious 指做事认真负责、一丝不苟。
constituent: A constituent is a part of a larger whole, or a person represented by an elected official.
constituent 可指整体的组成部分，也可指民选代表的选区选民。
deplete: To deplete a supply is to use up much of it so that little remains.
deplete 指大量消耗储备，使其显著减少。
devise: To devise a plan or method is to develop it through careful thought.
devise 指经过思考设计出计划、方法或方案。
elasticity: Elasticity is the ability to return to an earlier shape; in economics it describes responsiveness to a change.
elasticity 指弹性；在经济学中还可指某变量对另一变量变化的敏感程度。
endemic: A disease or condition is endemic when it is regularly found in a particular area or group.
endemic 指疾病或现象在某地区或群体中长期、经常存在，并非等于流行爆发。
evasive: An evasive answer avoids giving direct or clear information.
evasive 指回答闪烁其词、回避问题的。
exacerbate: To exacerbate a problem is to make it worse.
exacerbate 指使原本存在的问题恶化。
expedite: To expedite a process is to make it happen more quickly.
expedite 指加快进程、促使事情更快完成。
exploitation: Exploitation may mean unfairly taking advantage of people, or using a resource for a purpose.
exploitation 可指剥削、利用他人，也可中性地指资源开发或利用，需看语境。
impartial: An impartial person considers different sides without unfairly favoring one.
impartial 指公正、不偏袒某一方。
imperative: Something imperative is urgently necessary; in grammar, an imperative expresses a command.
imperative 可表示至关紧要、迫切必要；语法中指祈使式。
irreversible: An irreversible change cannot be undone or returned to its previous state.
irreversible 指变化无法撤销或恢复原状。
partition: To partition something is to divide it into separate parts; a partition is also such a division.
partition 指将整体分割成不同部分，也可指隔断或分区。
susceptible: Someone or something susceptible to an influence is easily affected by it.
susceptible to 表示容易受某种因素影响，常用于疾病、误差或外界作用。
wary: Someone wary of something is cautious because they suspect possible danger or problems.
wary 指因担心风险或问题而保持警惕、谨慎。
wholesale: Wholesale refers to selling goods in large quantities to retailers rather than directly to consumers.
wholesale 指批发的或批发经营；也可比喻大规模、全面的。
administrative: Administrative tasks involve organizing and managing an institution or its operations.
administrative 指与机构管理、行政事务有关的。
affectionate: An affectionate person shows warmth, fondness, or loving care.
affectionate 指表现出亲切、喜爱或关怀的。
amusement: Amusement is the feeling of being entertained or finding something funny.
amusement 指受到娱乐或觉得有趣、好笑的感受。
anonymous: An anonymous person or work is not identified by name.
anonymous 指未公开姓名、身份不明或署名未注明的。
approval: Approval is agreement that something is acceptable or may proceed.
approval 指认可、批准或同意某事继续进行。
aspect: An aspect is one particular feature or part of a situation or subject.
aspect 指事物的一个方面、特征或角度。
atmosphere: The atmosphere is the gases around a planet, or the general mood of a place.
atmosphere 可指大气层，也可指场所的气氛。
avenue: An avenue is a broad road, or a possible method of achieving a result.
avenue 指林荫大道，也可比喻实现目标的途径。
awkward: Something awkward is difficult to handle, uncomfortable, or socially embarrassing.
awkward 可表示棘手、不方便、别扭或令人尴尬的。
basis: The basis of an argument or decision is the main reason, evidence, or principle supporting it.
basis 指论证或决定所依据的理由、证据或原则。
behalf: To act on someone's behalf is to represent them or act for their benefit.
on someone's behalf 表示代表某人行事，或为某人的利益行事。
beneficiary: A beneficiary is a person or organization that receives a benefit, payment, or inheritance.
beneficiary 指福利、款项或遗产的受益人或受益机构。
betray: To betray someone is to break their trust; an expression can also betray a hidden feeling.
betray 可指背叛、辜负信任，也可指无意中流露感情。
blanket: A blanket is a covering used for warmth; a blanket rule applies broadly without distinguishing cases.
blanket 可指毯子；作修饰语时可表示笼统的、一刀切的。
broaden: To broaden something is to make its range, scope, or extent wider.
broaden 指拓宽范围、扩大眼界或涵盖面。
bureaucratic: Bureaucratic procedures involve formal administrative rules, sometimes excessively.
bureaucratic 指与官僚机构、繁琐行政程序有关的。
civic: Civic duties and activities relate to citizens or the community of a town or city.
civic 指公民的、市政的或社区公共事务的。
collateral: Collateral is an asset pledged as security for a loan; the adjective can mean additional or indirect.
collateral 可指贷款抵押品；作形容词还可表示附带或间接的。
combat: To combat a problem is to take action against it; combat also means fighting.
combat 既指战斗，也可指采取行动应对、遏制问题。
commentary: A commentary explains or offers opinions about events, text, or a performance.
commentary 指对事件、文本或表演的评论、解说。
commerce: Commerce is the activity of buying and selling goods and services, especially on a large scale.
commerce 指商业活动，尤其是较大规模的商品或服务交易。
complexity: Complexity is the state of having many interacting parts or being difficult to understand.
complexity 指复杂程度或由多个相互作用部分造成的复杂性。
compliant: A compliant person or organization follows rules or requirements; the word can also mean yielding.
compliant 指遵守规定、符合要求；也可形容顺从的。
conformity: Conformity is the act or state of following accepted standards, rules, or group expectations.
conformity 指遵循规范、标准或群体期望的一致性。
contract: A contract is a legally enforceable agreement; as a verb, contract can mean shrink or become smaller.
contract 可指具有法律约束力的合同；作动词也可表示收缩。
core: The core is the central or most essential part of something.
core 指中心部分或最核心、最重要的内容。
correspondence: Correspondence is an exchange of letters or messages; it can also mean a close matching between things.
correspondence 可指书信往来，也可指事物之间的对应关系。
corresponding: Corresponding items match or relate to one another in position, function, or meaning.
corresponding 指相应的、在位置或功能上对应的。
courtesy: Courtesy is polite consideration for others; something provided as a courtesy is offered as a polite gesture.
courtesy 指礼貌、体谅；as a courtesy 表示出于礼貌提供。
cryptic: A cryptic message is difficult to understand because its meaning is hidden or unclear.
cryptic 指含义隐晦、难以理解的。
cushion: A cushion is a soft pad; to cushion an impact is to reduce its force or harmful effect.
cushion 可指软垫；作动词指缓冲冲击或减轻不利影响。
desirable: Something desirable is worth having or achieving because it is useful or attractive.
desirable 指值得拥有或追求的、理想的。
deteriorate: To deteriorate is to become worse in quality, condition, or performance.
deteriorate 指质量、状态或性能逐渐恶化。
domestic: Domestic matters relate to the home or one's own country, rather than foreign affairs.
domestic 可指家庭内部的，也可指本国的、国内的。
ecosystem: An ecosystem is a community of living things and their environment; the word is also used for interconnected systems.
ecosystem 指生态系统，也常比喻相互关联的产业或技术体系。
embark: To embark on a project is to begin it, especially when it is significant or demanding.
embark on 指着手开展一项重要或有挑战性的事业、计划。
embody: To embody an idea or quality is to express or represent it in a concrete form.
embody 指以具体形式体现某种思想或品质。
emission: An emission is the release of gas, energy, or particles from a source.
emission 指气体、能量或粒子从源头向外释放、排放。
engagement: Engagement can mean involvement or participation, a formal commitment, or an arrangement to meet.
engagement 可指参与投入、订婚、约定或正式事务，取决于语境。
exchange: An exchange is the giving of one thing for another, or the sharing of information or ideas.
exchange 指交换、交流或互换。
faculty: Faculty can mean the teaching staff of an institution, or a person's natural ability to do something.
faculty 可指高校教职人员，也可指人的某种能力；具体用法有地区差异。
federal: Federal institutions relate to a system in which power is shared between national and regional governments.
federal 指联邦制国家中与联邦政府或联邦层级有关的。
finite: Something finite has a limit and is not infinite.
finite 指数量、范围或持续时间有限的，而非无限。
format: A format is an organized arrangement or specified structure for presenting information.
format 指信息呈现的格式、结构或安排方式。
formula: A formula is a mathematical expression or an established method used to achieve a result.
formula 可指数学公式，也可指固定的做事方法、配方。
generic: Something generic is not specific to a particular brand, type, or instance.
generic 指通用的、非特定品牌或特定实例的。
gesture: A gesture is a movement that communicates something, or an action expressing a feeling or intention.
gesture 指传达意思的手势，也可指表达态度的举动。
gravity: Gravity is the force attracting masses; it can also mean seriousness or importance.
gravity 指重力，也可指事情的严重性。
grievance: A grievance is a complaint about something believed to be unfair.
grievance 指因认为受到不公平对待而提出的不满或申诉。
guidance: Guidance is advice or direction that helps someone decide what to do.
guidance 指指导、指引或帮助决策的建议。
harmony: Harmony is a pleasing agreement between parts, or a state of peaceful cooperation.
harmony 指协调、和谐；音乐中还指和声。
hesitation: Hesitation is a pause or delay caused by uncertainty or reluctance.
hesitation 指因犹豫、不确定或不情愿而停顿。
horizon: The horizon is the line where land or sea seems to meet the sky, or the limit of knowledge and prospects.
horizon 指地平线，也可比喻眼界、视野或前景。
humanitarian: Humanitarian actions aim to reduce suffering and protect human welfare.
humanitarian 指以减轻痛苦、保障人类福祉为目标的人道主义的。
ideology: An ideology is an organized set of beliefs about politics, society, or how things should work.
ideology 指关于社会、政治或制度的一套思想观念。
immense: Something immense is extremely large in size, amount, or degree.
immense 指规模、数量或程度极大的。
immerse: To immerse someone or something is to put it fully into liquid or deeply involve it in an activity.
immerse 指浸入液体，也可指全身心投入某种活动。
index: An index is a list used to locate information, or a measure representing a group of values.
index 指索引，也可指反映一组数值的指数或指标。
informal: Informal language or arrangements are relaxed and not governed by strict official rules.
informal 指非正式的、随意的，不遵循严格官方程序的。
institute: An institute is an organization for a particular purpose; to institute a policy is to establish it.
institute 可指专门机构；作动词指建立、实施制度或政策。
instrumental: If something is instrumental in an outcome, it plays an important role in bringing it about.
instrumental in 表示对某结果的实现起重要作用；并非“使用仪器的”。
internal: Internal issues or parts exist within an organization, system, or body.
internal 指组织、系统或身体内部的。
intervention: An intervention is an action taken to change or improve a situation, often by a third party.
intervention 指为改变局面而采取的干预措施。
limited: Something limited has a restriction in amount, scope, or availability.
limited 指数量、范围或可获得性受到限制的。
linear: A linear relationship follows a straight-line pattern; linear can also describe a sequence progressing in order.
linear 可指线性关系，也可指按顺序推进的。
literal: The literal meaning of a word is its ordinary or exact meaning rather than a figurative one.
literal 指字面意义的、非比喻的。
logical: Something logical follows clear rules of reasoning and is consistent with the available premises.
logical 指符合逻辑推理规则、与前提一致的。
marine: Marine organisms or activities are connected with the sea.
marine 指海洋的、与海有关的。
matrix: A matrix is a rectangular array of numbers or a structure in which elements are arranged.
matrix 可指数学矩阵，也可指元素按一定结构排列的体系。
mature: Something mature is fully developed or has reached an advanced stage of growth.
mature 指成熟的、充分发展的。
medium: A medium is a means of communication, an environment, or a substance through which something passes.
medium 可指传播媒介、所处介质或传递某物的材料。
mobility: Mobility is the ability to move freely or change position, location, or social status.
mobility 指移动能力、流动性，也可指社会流动性。
morale: Morale is the confidence and enthusiasm of a group, especially in difficult circumstances.
morale 指群体的士气、信心或干劲。
niche: A niche is a specialized position or role suited to a particular need or market.
niche 指适合某类需求的专门领域、细分市场或生态位。
novelty: Novelty is the quality of being new, unusual, or unfamiliar.
novelty 指新颖性、新奇感；也可指新奇的小玩意。
nurture: To nurture someone or something is to care for and support their growth or development.
nurture 指照料、培养或促进发展。
obligation: An obligation is a duty or commitment that someone is required to fulfill.
obligation 指必须履行的义务或责任。
overview: An overview is a short presentation of the main features of a topic.
overview 指对主题主要内容的概览。
particle: A particle is a very small piece of matter; in grammar it can be a short functional word.
particle 指微小粒子；语法中可指小品词或助词。
passive: Someone passive tends not to take initiative or respond actively.
passive 指不主动采取行动、倾向于被动接受的。
personnel: Personnel are the people employed by an organization or assigned to a particular operation.
personnel 指机构人员、工作人员，通常作集合名词。
platform: A platform is a raised surface or a technological system that supports services or activities.
platform 指站台、平台，也可指支持其他服务的技术系统。
portion: A portion is one part or amount of a larger whole.
portion 指整体中的一部分或一定份额。
pose: To pose a problem or question is to present or create it; to pose can also mean taking a position for a picture.
pose 可指提出问题、造成威胁，也可指摆姿势。
potential: Potential is the capacity for something to develop or happen in the future.
potential 指未来可能发挥或实现的潜力，也可作形容词表示潜在的。
primary: Something primary is first in order, importance, or priority.
primary 指首要的、最重要的、第一位的。
primitive: Primitive can mean very simple or early in development; in computing, it can describe a basic operation or type.
primitive 可指原始、初级的；计算领域也指基础操作或基本类型。
privilege: A privilege is a special right, advantage, or permission not available to everyone.
privilege 指并非人人享有的特权、特殊待遇或权限。
profile: A profile is a description of a person or thing's main characteristics, or a user account record.
profile 指人物或事物的特征概况，也可指用户资料。
query: A query is a question or request for information, especially in a database or system.
query 指询问、查询，常用于数据库或系统检索。
quote: To quote is to repeat someone's exact words or cite a stated price.
quote 指引用原话，也可指报价。
realistic: A realistic goal or assessment takes actual conditions and limitations into account.
realistic 指考虑实际情况、切实可行的。
reform: Reform is a change intended to improve an institution, practice, or system.
reform 指为改善制度、做法或体系而进行的改革。
renew: To renew something is to make it valid again, continue it, or restore its strength.
renew 指续期、更新或恢复。
role: A role is the function or part someone or something performs in a situation.
role 指人或事物在情境中承担的角色或作用。
rudimentary: Something rudimentary is basic and not yet fully developed.
rudimentary 指初步的、基础的、尚未完善的。
scrutiny: Scrutiny is close and careful examination, often to assess whether something is acceptable.
scrutiny 指仔细审查或严密检视。
spatial: Spatial relationships concern positions, distances, and arrangements in space.
spatial 指空间位置、距离与布局关系的。
spectrum: A spectrum is a range of related values or types; in physics it can describe a distribution by wavelength or frequency.
spectrum 指一系列连续变化的范围；物理中指按波长或频率排列的谱。
status: Status is someone's or something's condition, position, or recognized standing.
status 指状态、地位或正式身份。
strategic: Strategic actions are planned to achieve an important long-term objective.
strategic 指着眼于长期目标、具有策略意义的。
symbolic: Something symbolic represents an idea rather than only having its literal function.
symbolic 指具有象征意义的。
symptom: A symptom is a change or problem that may indicate a condition or underlying cause.
symptom 指可能表明疾病或潜在问题的症状、征兆。
technical: Technical details relate to specialized methods, skills, or practical processes.
technical 指与专门技术、方法或专业操作有关的。
thesis: A thesis is a central claim being argued, or a substantial research document written for a degree.
thesis 可指论证的中心论点，也可指学位论文。
transaction: A transaction is an exchange or completed operation, especially in commerce or computing.
transaction 指交易，也可指计算机系统中一次完整的操作。
vibrant: Something vibrant is full of energy, color, or lively activity.
vibrant 指充满活力、生机或鲜明色彩的。
visual: Visual information is related to sight or the use of images.
visual 指与视觉或图像有关的。
volume: Volume is the amount of space occupied, a quantity of something, or one book in a series.
volume 可指体积、数量或一套书中的一卷。
worthy: Someone or something worthy of attention or respect deserves it.
worthy of 指值得受到关注、尊重或某种待遇。
exactly: Exactly means precisely or in complete agreement with a stated amount, description or time.
exactly 可表示完全准确、恰好如此；也可用于强调“正是这样”。
persistently: Persistently means continuing to do something despite difficulty, or repeatedly occurring over time.
persistently 表示持续不懈地做某事，或某种情况反复、持续出现。
routinely: Routinely means regularly as part of an established practice, not necessarily without thought.
routinely 指作为常规程序经常做某事，并不必然含有“机械、不动脑”的贬义。
habitually: Habitually means doing something as a settled habit, sometimes with a critical implication.
habitually 指习惯性地做某事，语境中有时带有批评意味。
unspoken: Unspoken describes something not said aloud but often understood or implied.
unspoken 指虽未说出口，却可能被双方理解或默认为存在的。
figurative: Figurative language uses a nonliteral meaning, often through comparison or imagery.
figurative 指比喻性、非字面意义的语言表达。
metaphorical: Metaphorical describes language that treats one thing as another to illuminate a likeness.
metaphorical 指隐喻性的表达，以一类事物说明另一类事物。
detached: Detached can mean physically separate or emotionally uninvolved; it need not mean impartial.
detached 可指分离的或情感上超然的，不一定等于公正无偏。
distinguishable: Distinguishable means capable of being recognized as different from something else.
distinguishable 指能够辨认出与其他事物不同，不一定意味着差别很大。
complimentary: Complimentary can mean praising, or supplied without charge, depending on context.
complimentary 可指表示赞美的，也可指免费赠送的；不要与 complementary 混淆。
coincident: Coincident events occur at the same time or share a position; causation is not implied.
coincident 指时间上同时发生或位置上重合；并不自动说明有因果关系。
coincidence: A coincidence is a striking concurrence of events without an established causal connection.
coincidence 指事件巧合发生，但尚未建立其因果联系。
occurrence: An occurrence is an event or instance of something happening, not necessarily a frequent one.
occurrence 指某次事件或发生的实例，单词本身不表示发生频繁。
empiricism: Empiricism emphasizes experience or observation as a source of knowledge.
empiricism 指强调经验与观察在知识形成中作用的经验主义立场。
analytic: Analytic describes examining parts or relations; it also has specialized philosophical and mathematical uses.
analytic 指分析性的；在哲学和数学等领域也有更严格的专门含义。
analytical: Analytical means involving careful examination of evidence, structure or relationships.
analytical 指通过细致分析证据、结构或关系来理解问题的。
synthesis: A synthesis combines separate ideas or results into a coherent whole.
synthesis 指把不同观点或结果综合为一个有内在联系的整体。
noteworthy: Noteworthy means deserving attention because of importance or unusual interest.
noteworthy 指因重要或特别而值得注意，并不必然表示程度极大。
notable: Notable means important, conspicuous, or sufficiently unusual to merit attention.
notable 指显著或值得注意；也可能专指重要、知名的人物。
noticeable: Noticeable means easy enough to perceive, without necessarily being significant.
noticeable 指能被察觉到，不保证其具有实际或统计上的重要性。
observable: Observable means capable of being detected through observation or measurement.
observable 指可以通过观察或测量发现的；物理学中还可能具有专门含义。
visible: Visible means able to be seen, or plainly apparent in a broader sense.
visible 指肉眼可见，也可引申为容易察觉或公开可见的。
concealed: Concealed describes something intentionally hidden or kept out of view.
concealed 指被隐藏起来、不让人看见的，常暗示有意隐蔽。
doubtful: Doubtful means uncertain or unlikely, and may describe a person who has doubts.
doubtful 可指有疑虑的、不确定的，也可指事情不大可能发生。
skepticism: Skepticism is a questioning attitude that calls for adequate evidence before acceptance.
skepticism 指在接受主张前要求充分证据的怀疑态度，不等于一概否认。
scepticism: Scepticism is the usual British spelling of skepticism, a questioning attitude to claims.
scepticism 是 skepticism 的常见英式拼写，强调对主张保持审慎怀疑。
suspicious: Suspicious means suspecting something wrong or giving reason for suspicion.
suspicious 可形容一个人心存怀疑，也可形容某事令人起疑。
demonstrable: Demonstrable describes something that can be shown convincingly with evidence or reasoning.
demonstrable 指能够通过证据或论证加以证明或清楚展示的。
grain: A grain is a tiny particle, a cereal seed, or the texture and pattern of a material.
grain 可指谷粒、细小颗粒，也可指木材或图像等的纹理。
deter: To deter is to discourage an action by making its risks or costs seem too great.
deter 指通过潜在风险或代价使人打消行动念头，不必真正阻止行动发生。
obstruct: To obstruct is to block a route, process or action, physically or figuratively.
obstruct 指阻塞通道或妨碍进程，既可具体也可抽象。
hamper: To hamper is to make progress or activity harder without necessarily stopping it.
hamper 指妨碍进展、增加困难，但通常不表示完全停止。
resume: To resume is to begin again after an interruption, or to continue from where something stopped.
resume 指中断后恢复或继续，不应与 résumé（简历）混为一谈。
revive: To revive is to bring back activity, strength, interest or a condition that had declined.
revive 指使衰退或停止的活动、活力、兴趣等重新恢复。
reopen: To reopen is to open again, or to return to a matter that had been considered closed.
reopen 指重新开放，也可指重新讨论本已结束的问题。
responsible: Responsible means having a duty or accountability, or causing something in a specified context.
responsible 指负有职责或责任；be responsible for 也可表示“是……的原因”。
credulity: Credulity is excessive readiness to believe claims without sufficient evidence.
credulity 指不加充分核查便轻易相信的倾向，常带贬义。
incongruity: Incongruity is a mismatch between things expected to fit together.
incongruity 指本应协调的事物之间出现不相称、不一致的情况。
inequality: Inequality is a difference in size, resources, opportunities, or mathematical values.
inequality 指数量、资源或机会等的不平等；数学中也指不等关系。
inequity: Inequity is an unfair difference or arrangement, emphasizing injustice rather than mere difference.
inequity 指不公正、不公平的差异，强调正义问题而不仅是数量不同。
conflate: To conflate is to treat distinct ideas or events as if they were one and the same.
conflate 指把本应区分的概念或事件混为一谈，不只是普通地比较。
understate: To understate is to describe a quantity or importance as smaller than it is.
understate 指把数量、程度或重要性说得比实际低。
overstate: To overstate is to describe something as greater or more certain than the evidence supports.
overstate 指夸大规模、程度或确定性，超出实际或证据所支持的范围。
underscore: To underscore is to emphasize or draw attention to a point; literally, to underline.
underscore 指强调某一点；字面也可表示在文字下画线。
investigate: To investigate is to examine a question or event systematically to establish what happened or why.
investigate 指为弄清事实、原因而系统调查或研究。
survey: A survey systematically collects information, or examines an area or topic from a broad perspective.
survey 可指问卷调查、系统考察，也可指对某主题作总体概览。
reiterate: To reiterate is to state something again, usually for emphasis or clarity.
reiterate 指为强调或澄清而再次重申某个观点。
paraphrase: To paraphrase is to express the same meaning in different words.
paraphrase 指用不同措辞转述相同意思，而不只是删短文本。
condense: To condense is to make something shorter or denser while preserving its essentials.
condense 指浓缩、压缩篇幅或使物质凝结；用于文本时强调保留要点。
distill: To distill is to extract the essence of something; literally, to purify by heating and cooling.
distill 可指提炼观点的精华；本义为蒸馏提纯。
hesitant: Hesitant describes being slow to act or speak because of uncertainty, doubt, or caution.
hesitant 指因犹豫、拿不准或谨慎而迟迟未行动或开口，不一定表示不愿意。
cynical: Cynical means distrustful of people’s sincerity or motives, often assuming self-interest.
cynical 指对他人的诚意或动机持不信任态度，常认定对方出于私利；不同于一般的审慎怀疑。
reign: A reign is a period of a ruler’s power; to reign can also mean to be dominant in a place or time.
reign 作名词指君主统治时期，作动词指统治，也可引申为某种事物占主导地位。
rein: A rein is a strap used to guide a horse; to rein in something means to restrain or control it.
rein 本指控制马匹的缰绳，rein in 常指约束、控制支出、情绪或行为。
improbable: Improbable describes something unlikely to happen or be true, but not logically impossible.
improbable 表示发生或属实的可能性很小，但并非逻辑上不可能。
thoroughness: Thoroughness is the quality of checking or doing all relevant parts carefully and completely.
thoroughness 指做事周全、仔细、不遗漏重要环节，而不只是篇幅长或程序复杂。
coercion: Coercion is the use of threats, pressure, or force to make someone act against their free choice.
coercion 指用威胁、强制或施压迫使他人行事，与自愿同意或普通劝说不同。
specific: Specific means precisely identified or restricted to a particular thing, case, or purpose.
specific 表示明确、具体或针对某一对象的；不一定意味着“特殊”或“罕见”。
cumbersome: Cumbersome describes something awkward or difficult to handle because it is large or unnecessarily complicated.
cumbersome 形容物体笨重、操作不便，或流程因繁琐而难以使用；不只是“耗时”。
comprehend: To comprehend means to grasp the meaning, nature, or implications of something.
comprehend 指理解某事的含义、性质或影响，强调领会内容；并非单指读懂文字。
inertia: In physics, inertia is resistance to a change in motion; figuratively, it is resistance to changing established habits or systems.
inertia 在物理学中指惯性；引申指组织、制度或习惯难以改变的惰性。
cognitive: Cognitive describes processes related to thinking, learning, perceiving, remembering, and reasoning.
cognitive 指与思考、学习、感知、记忆及推理等认知过程有关，而不等于“智力高”。
predicate: In grammar, a predicate says something about the subject; in logic, a predicate expresses a property or relation.
predicate 在语法中指对主语作出陈述的谓语部分；在逻辑中指表示性质或关系的谓词。
estimation: Estimation is the process of calculating an approximate amount or value from available information.
estimation 是根据现有信息估算大致数值或数量的过程。
modest: Modest describes something limited in size, scale or ambition, or a person who does not boast.
modest 可指规模、幅度不大，也可形容人谦逊、不自夸。
deceptive: Deceptive describes something that misleads, whether deliberately or because it gives a false impression.
deceptive 指具有误导性、容易造成错误印象的；不一定表示有意欺骗。
fallacy: A fallacy is a mistaken belief or a flaw in reasoning that makes an argument unreliable.
fallacy 指错误观念或推理谬误，使论证不能成立。
fallacious: Fallacious reasoning contains an error in logic, even if its conclusion happens to be true.
fallacious 形容推理存在逻辑错误；结论偶然正确也不等于推理有效。
ambivalence: Ambivalence is the experience of opposing feelings or attitudes about the same person, idea, or decision.
ambivalence 指对同一对象同时怀有相互矛盾的情感或态度，并不只是拿不定主意。
longitudinal: A longitudinal study follows the same people, variables, or processes over a period of time.
longitudinal 指纵向的；纵向研究在一段时间内持续观察同一对象或过程。
homogeneity: Homogeneity is the quality of being similar or uniform in relevant characteristics.
homogeneity 指在有关特征上较为一致、同质；并不表示所有方面都完全相同。
surmise: To surmise is to form an opinion from limited evidence rather than direct knowledge.
surmise 表示根据有限线索作出推测，而不是已经证实的结论。
reciprocal: Reciprocal describes actions, feelings, or relationships that operate in both directions.
reciprocal 表示相互的、双向的，常用于义务、关系或影响。
juxtaposition: Juxtaposition is the placement of two things side by side to reveal a contrast or connection.
juxtaposition 指把事物并置，以突出它们之间的对比或联系。
deterrent: A deterrent is something that discourages an action by making it less attractive or more costly.
deterrent 指让人因预期成本或后果而打消某种行动念头的威慑因素。
relativity: Relativity is the dependence of a comparison or judgment on a frame of reference; in physics it also names Einstein’s theories.
relativity 可指相对性，即判断依赖参照系；在物理学中也指相对论。
gun: A gun is a device designed to fire a projectile; the word may also describe a tool that sprays or dispenses material.
gun 主要指枪械，也可用于喷枪、胶枪等具有发射或喷出功能的工具。
evil: Evil refers to profound wrongdoing or moral harm; as an adjective, it describes something morally bad.
evil 作名词指邪恶或严重的恶行；作形容词表示邪恶的、有害的。
married: Married describes a person who has a spouse, or something associated with marriage.
married 通常指已婚的，也可表示与婚姻有关的。
uncle: An uncle is a parent's brother or the husband of a parent's sibling.
uncle 指叔叔、伯伯、舅舅或姑父、姨父等男性长辈；具体亲属关系需按语境区分。
holy: Holy describes something regarded as sacred, especially in a religious context.
holy 指神圣的、受到宗教尊崇的，也可形容纯洁而崇高。
eight: Eight is the number after seven and before nine.
eight 是数字八，作形容词时表示八个的。
finger: A finger is one of the digits of the hand, usually distinguished from the thumb; it can also act as a verb.
finger 作名词指手指；作动词可表示用手指触碰、指认或拨弄。
floor: A floor is the surface people stand on inside a room, or a level of a building.
floor 指室内地面或楼层，也可指最低限度；作动词有铺地板、击倒等意思。
mistake: A mistake is something done or understood incorrectly; to mistake someone or something is to identify it wrongly.
mistake 作名词指错误、误会；作动词表示误认、弄错，常见 make a mistake。
army: An army is the military force trained to fight on land; the word may also refer to a very large group.
army 通常指陆军或一支军队，也可比喻人数众多的一群人。
bless: To bless is to ask for divine favor, or to express gratitude and good wishes.
bless 表示祈求神灵赐福、祝福某人；也用于表达感激。
duke: A duke is a high-ranking male noble in certain European systems of titles.
duke 指欧洲贵族等级中的公爵，具体地位因国家和历史时期而异。
afternoon: Afternoon is the part of the day between noon and evening.
afternoon 指从中午过后到傍晚之间的下午时段。
difficult: Something difficult requires considerable effort, skill or thought to do or understand.
difficult 形容事情困难、费力或难以理解，也可形容人难相处。
sad: Sad describes a feeling of unhappiness, sorrow or regret.
sad 表示难过、悲伤，也可指令人遗憾或不幸的情况。
sun: The sun is the star at the center of our solar system; the word can also mean sunlight.
sun 指太阳，也可指阳光；作动词可表示晒太阳或使某物受日照。
forest: A forest is a large area of land covered mainly with trees.
forest 指森林或林地，也可表示成片茂密的树木。
governor: A governor is an official who governs a state, region or institution; it can also name a control mechanism.
governor 可指州长、总督等管理者；技术语境中还可指调速器或控制装置。
marriage: Marriage is a legally or socially recognized union between people; it may also mean the ceremony itself.
marriage 指婚姻关系，也可指结婚这件事或婚礼；与 wedding 的使用范围不同。
royal: Royal describes something related to a king, queen or royal family.
royal 表示王室的、皇家的，有时引申为盛大、尊贵的。
twenty: Twenty is the number equal to two groups of ten.
twenty 是数字二十，作限定词表示二十个。
university: A university is an institution of higher education and research that usually awards academic degrees.
university 指大学，通常开展高等教育和科研并授予学位。
stone: Stone is hard natural mineral material; a stone can also mean a small rock or a gemstone.
stone 可指石头、石料或宝石；也可用于果核、结石等特定语境。
billion: In modern English, a billion means one thousand million, or 1,000,000,000.
现代英语中的 billion 指十亿（10⁹），不应译作一万亿。
writing: Writing is the act of producing written language, or text created in that way.
writing 可指书写行为，也可指文字作品、文章或笔迹。
sky: The sky is the space seen above the earth, especially where clouds and celestial objects appear.
sky 指从地面仰望的天空，也可用于天气或天空的颜色。
bishop: A bishop is a senior religious official in certain Christian churches; in chess, a bishop is a piece.
bishop 在部分基督教教会中指主教；国际象棋中指象。
box: A box is a container, usually with flat sides; the word also has meanings in sport and computing.
box 指盒子、箱子或方框；作动词可指装箱，亦可指拳击。
murder: Murder is the unlawful intentional killing of another person; the word can also be a verb.
murder 通常指谋杀、故意非法杀人；具体法律定义因司法制度而异。
priest: A priest is a religious official who conducts ceremonies in certain religions.
priest 可指祭司、神父等主持宗教仪式者；与 pastor、minister 的角色不完全相同。
revolt: A revolt is organized resistance against authority; to revolt is to rebel or to feel strong disgust.
revolt 作名词指反抗、起义；作动词可表示反叛或强烈反感。
smoke: Smoke consists of gases and fine particles produced by burning; to smoke can mean to emit smoke or use tobacco.
smoke 作名词指烟雾；作动词可表示冒烟、吸烟或烟熏。
tax: A tax is money that a government requires people or organizations to pay.
tax 指税、税款；作动词表示征税，也可表示给某人或某物增加负担。
breath: Breath is the air drawn into or expelled from the lungs, or one act of breathing.
breath 是名词，指呼吸、气息或一口气；动词形式为 breathe。
college: A college is an institution of higher education or a division within a university; usage differs by country.
college 指学院或高等学校；在美国与英国的教育体系中，其具体含义不完全相同。
colonel: A colonel is a senior military officer, typically ranking above a lieutenant colonel.
colonel 指上校等高级军官，英语读音与拼写差异较大。
lake: A lake is an inland body of water surrounded by land.
lake 指湖泊，通常是被陆地包围的大片水域。
parent: A parent is a mother, father or another person who has parental responsibility for a child.
parent 指父母之一或承担父母责任的人；在技术领域还可表示上级或父节点。
police: The police are the public organization responsible for enforcing laws and maintaining order.
police 指警察或警察机构；作动词表示维持秩序、监管。
profess: To profess is to declare or claim something, often publicly or formally.
profess 指公开声称、表白；也可表示以某职业为业，并不一定暗示虚伪。
reader: A reader is someone who reads; it may also mean a book, device or person that reads or checks text.
reader 指读者，也可指分级读物、阅读设备或审稿、校对人员。
terrible: Terrible describes something very bad, unpleasant or frightening.
terrible 表示极差的、可怕的或严重的；日常口语中常强调程度很高。
writer: A writer is someone who produces books, articles or other written material.
writer 指作者、作家或撰稿人，也可泛指从事写作的人。
creature: A creature is a living being, especially an animal; it may also refer to an imaginary being.
creature 指生物、动物，也可指传说中的怪物或虚构生灵。
modern: Modern describes something belonging to the present or a relatively recent period.
modern 指现代的、近代的；具体时间范围取决于讨论的学科和语境。
speaking: Speaking is the act or skill of using spoken language; as an adjective it can describe someone who speaks.
speaking 指说话、口语表达；作形容词可指讲话的或使用某种语言的。
thick: Thick describes something with a large distance between opposite surfaces, or a dense consistency.
thick 可表示厚的、粗的、浓稠的、密集的；具体意义随修饰对象而变。
victory: Victory is success in a competition, conflict or struggle.
victory 指比赛、战争或斗争中的胜利；常见 win a victory、claim victory。
fish: A fish is an aquatic vertebrate with gills; the word also means its flesh as food or the act of catching fish.
fish 可指鱼、鱼肉；作动词表示捕鱼、钓鱼，复数 fish 与 fishes 用途不同。
rain: Rain is water falling from clouds in drops; to rain is to fall as rain.
rain 作名词指雨；作动词表示下雨，也可比喻大量落下。
cup: A cup is a small drinking vessel; it may also mean a unit of capacity or a prize.
cup 指杯子，也可指量杯计量单位、奖杯或杯赛。
educate: To educate is to teach someone knowledge, skills or ways of thinking.
educate 指教育、培养，使人获得知识、技能或判断能力。
favor: A favor is a kind act done to help someone; to favor can mean to prefer or support.
favor（英式拼写 favour）作名词指帮忙、人情；作动词指偏爱、支持。
fruit: Fruit is the edible product of certain plants, or more generally the result of an effort.
fruit 指水果、果实，也可比喻努力的成果。
grand: Grand describes something impressive, magnificent or large in scale.
grand 表示宏伟、壮观或规模庞大的；在某些口语语境中还可表示极好。
green: Green is the color between blue and yellow; it can also describe youth, inexperience or environmental concerns.
green 指绿色；也可表示未成熟、缺乏经验或与环境保护有关。
invite: To invite is to ask someone to attend or take part, or to encourage something to happen.
invite 指邀请，也可表示引起、招致某种结果。
religious: Religious describes something connected with religion or a person devoted to religious beliefs.
religious 指宗教的、信仰虔诚的，也可形容近乎一丝不苟的行为。
sell: To sell is to exchange goods or services for money; it can also mean to persuade someone to accept an idea.
sell 指出售、销售；引申可表示说服某人接受想法，也可用于背叛。
terror: Terror is extreme fear, especially fear caused by danger or violence.
terror 指极度恐惧、惊恐；也可用于恐怖行动或令人恐惧的事物。
turning: A turning is a change of direction, a bend or the act of turning something.
turning 指转向、转弯，也可表示旋转或车削加工。
yard: A yard is an outdoor area next to a building; as a unit it equals three feet.
yard 可指庭院、场地；作为长度单位，一码等于三英尺。
acquaint: To acquaint someone with something is to make them familiar with it.
acquaint 通常用于 acquaint someone with something，表示使某人了解或熟悉某事。
artist: An artist is someone who creates visual art or performs another creative art.
artist 指艺术家，也可根据语境指画家、表演艺术工作者。
brave: Brave describes someone willing to face danger, pain or difficulty despite fear.
brave 指勇敢的，强调即使害怕仍愿意面对危险或困难。
confess: To confess is to admit something, especially wrongdoing or a private feeling.
confess 指坦白、承认过错，也可表示倾诉或告解。
injure: To injure is to cause physical harm or damage, and sometimes to harm someone's interests or feelings.
injure 指使身体受伤、损伤，也可引申为损害利益或感情。
leg: A leg is a limb used for standing or walking; it can also be one stage of a journey or competition.
leg 指腿，也可指旅程的一段、比赛的一个赛段。
machine: A machine is a device that uses power to perform a task.
machine 指机器或机械装置；也可指组织严密的大型机构。
nerve: A nerve carries signals between parts of the body and the nervous system; nerve also means courage or boldness.
nerve 指神经；口语中也可指胆量、勇气或厚脸皮。
sick: Sick describes someone who is ill or feeling nauseated; it may also express disgust.
sick 表示生病的、恶心的；在不同英语变体中也有“厌烦、反感”的用法。
stranger: A stranger is a person one does not know, or someone unfamiliar with a place or activity.
stranger 指陌生人；be no stranger to something 表示对某事并不陌生。
wonderful: Wonderful describes something very good, impressive or delightful.
wonderful 表示极好的、令人愉快或赞叹的。
bitter: Bitter describes a sharp, unpleasant taste, painful emotions or severe cold.
bitter 可指苦味的，也可形容怨恨、痛苦或严寒。
branch: A branch is a part of a tree growing from its trunk, or a division of an organization or subject.
branch 指树枝，也可指分支机构、学科分支或河流支流。
council: A council is a group of people appointed or elected to advise or make decisions.
council 指议会、委员会等集体议事或决策机构；与 counsel（建议）不同。
hat: A hat is a covering worn on the head, often for warmth, shade or style.
hat 指帽子；在比喻表达中可表示身份、职责，例如 wear many hats。
kiss: To kiss is to touch someone or something with the lips; a kiss is the action itself.
kiss 作动词表示亲吻；作名词指吻。
north: North is the direction opposite south; the word can also describe a northern location.
north 表示北方、向北，也可用于描述某地的北部。
pity: Pity is sympathy for another person's suffering, or regret about an unfortunate situation.
pity 指怜悯、同情，也可表示遗憾；It's a pity 表示“真可惜”。
prisoner: A prisoner is someone held in custody or confined, often after arrest or conviction.
prisoner 指被拘押或监禁的人，也可指战俘。
student: A student is someone who studies, especially at a school, college or university.
student 指学生，也可指某个领域的学习者或研究者。
surround: To surround is to be or move all around someone or something.
surround 指围绕、包围，也可用于环境、声音或信息从四周环绕的情况。
tie: To tie is to fasten something with a cord or knot; as a noun, a tie may be a necktie, connection or equal score.
tie 作动词指系、打结；作名词可指领带、联系或平局。
valley: A valley is a low area of land between hills or mountains, often with a river running through it.
valley 指山谷、河谷，也可用于地形中呈谷状的低洼区域。
administer: To administer is to manage an organization or process, or to give a medicine or treatment.
administer 可指管理、执行，也可表示给药或实施治疗，语境须区分。
dread: Dread is a strong fear of something that may happen; to dread is to fear anticipating it.
dread 指对即将发生之事的强烈恐惧；作动词表示惧怕面对。
hate: To hate is to feel intense dislike; hate is also a noun for that feeling.
hate 指憎恨、极度讨厌；强度通常高于 dislike。
possession: Possession means owning or controlling something, or an item that someone owns.
possession 指拥有、占有，也可指个人财物；法律语境中还可能强调实际控制。
secretary: A secretary is a person who handles administrative tasks, or an official holding a particular government post.
secretary 指秘书、行政助理，也可指某些政府部门的部长或官员。
anxious: Anxious can mean worried or uneasy; it can also mean eager for something to happen.
anxious 可指焦虑、担忧，也可表示急切盼望；be anxious about 与 be anxious to 的语义侧重不同。
aunt: An aunt is a parent's sister or the wife of a parent's sibling.
aunt 指姑姑、姨妈、伯母、婶婶、舅妈等女性长辈，汉语具体称谓依亲属关系而定。
conditions: Conditions are the circumstances that influence a situation, or the requirements that must be met.
conditions 是 condition 的复数，常指条件、环境状况，也可指合同或协议中的条款。
east: East is the direction in which the sun generally rises; it can also describe an eastern location.
east 指东方、向东，也可表示某地区的东部。
excellent: Excellent describes something of exceptionally high quality.
excellent 表示极好的、出色的，程度通常高于 good。
instruct: To instruct is to teach, explain how to do something, or give someone an authoritative direction.
instruct 表示指导、教授，也可指正式指示或命令。
mix: To mix is to combine different substances or things; a mix is the result or combination.
mix 指混合、掺和；作名词可指混合物、组合或混合状态。
nine: Nine is the number after eight and before ten.
nine 是数字九，作限定词表示九个。
pause: A pause is a short stop or break; to pause is to stop temporarily.
pause 指短暂停顿或暂停；与 stop 相比，通常暗示之后可能继续。
silver: Silver is a precious, shiny gray-white metal; it can also describe the color of that metal.
silver 指银这种金属，也可指银色、银器或银制品。
sport: Sport is physical activity involving skill or competition, or recreation more generally.
sport 指体育运动、竞技项目，也可泛指娱乐活动。
square: A square is a shape with four equal sides and right angles; it can also mean a public space or a number multiplied by itself.
square 可指正方形、广场或平方；作形容词、动词时意义也很多。
desert: A desert is a very dry region with little rainfall; to desert someone is to abandon them.
desert 作名词指沙漠；作动词表示抛弃、擅离，读音与重音不同。
glass: Glass is a hard transparent material used for windows; a glass is also a drinking container.
glass 指玻璃材料，也可指玻璃杯、镜片等。
intelligent: Intelligent describes the ability to learn, reason and understand well.
intelligent 表示聪明、理解力强；也可形容具有智能功能的系统。
majesty: Majesty is impressive greatness or dignity; it is also used as a form of address for a monarch.
majesty 指威严、雄伟；Your Majesty 是对君主的尊称。
pale: Pale describes a light, weak or washed-out color, or a face lacking its usual color.
pale 表示苍白的、颜色淡的；也可引申为缺乏力度或黯然失色。
post: A post can be a position, pole, message or mail; to post is to send or publish something.
post 可指岗位、柱子、邮件或帖子；作动词表示寄送、发布等。
professor: A professor is a senior academic who teaches or conducts research at a university.
professor 指大学教授；学术职级的具体含义因国家和院校而异。
retire: To retire is to stop working, leave a position or withdraw from an activity.
retire 指退休、退役或退出；也可指撤离、退去。
ruin: To ruin is to damage something severely; ruins are remains of destroyed buildings.
ruin 作动词指毁坏、破坏；作名词可指废墟、毁灭或破产。
steps: Steps are movements made while walking, or a sequence of actions in a process.
steps 是 step 的复数，可指脚步、台阶，也可指程序中的步骤。
tire: To tire is to become weary or make someone weary; as a noun, tire means the rubber outer part of a wheel.
tire 作动词指疲倦、使厌烦；作名词指轮胎（英式亦拼作 tyre）。
worse: Worse is the comparative form of bad or badly; it describes a lower quality or a more unfavorable situation.
worse 是 bad 或 badly 的比较级，表示更坏、更差，不能与 worst（最高级）混用。
citizen: A citizen is a legally recognized member of a country or political community.
citizen 指公民，强调政治共同体中的法律身份；与 resident（居民）不同。
club: A club is an organized group of people with a shared interest; it may also mean a heavy stick or a place for social activities.
club 可指有共同兴趣的社团、俱乐部，也可指棍棒或供人社交活动的场所。
iron: Iron is a strong metal; an iron is also a heated tool for pressing clothes, and to iron means to smooth fabric.
iron 既指铁这种金属，也指熨斗；作动词时表示熨烫衣物。
loud: Loud describes a sound that is strong and easy to hear, sometimes to an unpleasant degree.
loud 表示声音响亮、音量大；也可能带有“吵闹”的负面意味。
sale: A sale is an exchange in which something is sold; it can also mean a period when goods are offered at reduced prices.
sale 可指销售、交易，也可指商店的促销、打折活动。
shut: To shut is to close something or stop it from being open or operating.
shut 指关上、关闭；也可指使机器或机构停止运作。
greek: Greek refers to the language, people, or culture of Greece.
Greek 可指希腊语，也可指希腊人或希腊的文化；作形容词时表示“希腊的”。
shake: To shake is to move rapidly back and forth; it may describe trembling, mixing, or a gesture of greeting.
shake 指摇动、晃动、颤抖；也可表示摇匀，或握手等动作。
player: A player is someone who participates in a game, sport, or performance.
player 指运动员、游戏参与者，也可指乐器演奏者等表演者。
prayer: A prayer is words spoken or thought to address a deity; it may also express an earnest hope or request.
prayer 指祈祷、祷词；在一般语境中也可指恳切的愿望或请求。
wealth: Wealth is an abundance of money, property, or other resources; it can also mean a rich supply of something.
wealth 指财富、财产，也可泛指某种事物的丰富积累，如大量知识。
successful: Successful means achieving a goal or having the desired result.
successful 表示达到目标、获得预期结果；既可形容个人，也可形容行动、项目。
today: Today means the present day; more broadly, it can refer to the current period.
today 指今天，也可泛指当今、目前这个时代。
motion: Motion is movement; in a formal meeting, a motion is a proposal to be considered or voted on.
motion 指运动、移动；在会议或议会中还可指正式提出的动议。
double: Double means twice as much or made of two parts; it can also mean to become twice as large.
double 表示两倍的、双重的；作动词时可表示翻倍。
twelve: twelve 是基数词“十二”，其序数词为 twelfth。
mission: A mission is an important task or purpose assigned to a person or group.
mission 指使命、重要任务；也可指外交使团或宗教传教活动。
opening: An opening is a gap, an opportunity, or the beginning of an event; it can also describe the act of opening.
opening 指开口、空缺、机会，也可表示开幕、开始或打开这一动作。
station: A station is a place where transport stops or a facility serving a particular function.
station 可指车站，也可指警察局、广播电台或科研观测站等设施。
exercise: Exercise is physical activity or practice; to exercise can mean to train or to use a right or power.
exercise 指体育锻炼、练习；作动词时也可表示行使权利或权力。
universe: The universe is all of space, time, matter, and energy considered as a whole.
universe 指宇宙，即整体意义上的时空、物质和能量。
proud: Proud means feeling satisfaction in an achievement or connection; it can sometimes suggest excessive self-importance.
proud 表示自豪、骄傲；根据语境也可能指自负。
score: A score is the number of points gained; to score is to earn points or achieve a result.
score 指比赛得分、成绩；作动词时指得分，也可表示取得成果。
affairs: Affairs are matters, events, or activities that require attention, often in public or personal life.
affairs 是 affair 的复数，可指事务、事情、时事或私人关系。
leading: Leading means being in front, most important, or especially successful in a field.
leading 表示领先的、首要的，也可指某领域有影响力的。
existent: Existent means having real being or actually existing.
existent 表示存在的、实际存在的；语体比 existing 更正式。
peculiar: Peculiar can mean unusual or strange, or characteristic of a particular person or place.
peculiar 可表示奇特的、反常的，也可表示某人或某地特有的。
president: A president is the elected head of a republic or the person who leads an organization.
president 可指共和国总统，也可指机构、大学或公司的负责人。
fort: A fort is a building or place designed for military defense.
fort 指堡垒、要塞，通常为防御而建造。
gate: A gate is a movable barrier in a fence or wall; it can also be an entry point at an airport.
gate 指大门、闸门；在机场也指登机口。
lean: To lean is to bend or incline; lean can also describe someone thin or food low in fat.
lean 作动词时指倾斜、倚靠；作形容词时指瘦的或脂肪少的。
path: A path is a route or track; figuratively, it may be a course of action or development.
path 指道路、小径；也可比喻行动或发展路径。
vast: Vast means extremely large in area, amount, or scale.
vast 表示广阔的、巨大的，强调范围或数量之大。
saint: A saint is a person honored for exceptional holiness; informally, it may mean a very kind person.
saint 指圣徒、圣人；非正式语境中也可形容非常善良的人。
reserve: To reserve is to keep something for later use; a reserve is an extra supply or a protected area.
reserve 作动词指预留、保留；作名词可指储备或自然保护区。
communal: Communal describes something shared by members of a community or group.
communal 指集体共有、社区共享的，如公共厨房。
interesting: Interesting describes something that attracts curiosity or attention.
interesting 表示有趣的、引人关注的；不同于 interested（感兴趣的）。
gift: A gift is something given without payment; it may also refer to a natural talent.
gift 指礼物、赠品，也可表示天赋、才能。
luck: Luck is success or failure attributed to chance rather than deliberate effort.
luck 指运气、机遇；good luck 是好运，也常用于祝福。
pack: To pack is to put things into a container for transport; a pack is a bundle or a group.
pack 作动词指打包、装箱；作名词可指一包、一群或一副等。
shop: A shop is a place that sells goods or services; to shop is to look for and buy things.
shop 指商店；作动词时表示购物、选购。
slip: To slip is to slide unintentionally or make a small mistake; a slip can be such an error.
slip 可指滑倒、失足，也可指小失误；名词还可指小纸条。
absent: Absent means not present where someone is expected; it may also describe a lack of something.
absent 指缺席、不在场；也可表示缺乏某种事物。
custom: A custom is a traditional practice; as an adjective, custom refers to something made for a particular need.
custom 作名词指习俗、惯例；作形容词指量身定制的。
deeply: Deeply means to a great depth or with strong intensity, often of feeling or concern.
deeply 指深深地；常用于表示感情、影响或关注的程度很深。
engine: An engine is a machine that converts energy into mechanical power; figuratively, it can drive a process.
engine 指发动机、引擎；比喻用法中也可指推动发展的力量。
honest: Honest means truthful, sincere, and not intending to deceive.
honest 表示诚实的、坦率的、不欺骗的。
surface: A surface is the outer layer of something; to surface can mean to come into view or become known.
surface 指表面；作动词时表示浮出水面或（问题）显现。
village: A village is a small settlement, usually smaller than a town.
village 指村庄、乡村聚落，规模通常小于城镇。
existence: Existence is the state or fact of being real or living.
existence 指存在、生存；常见结构是 the existence of（……的存在）。
perfectly: Perfectly means completely or in an excellent manner; sometimes it simply means very well.
perfectly 表示完美地、完全地；在 perfectly clear 等表达中常表示“非常清楚”。
beg: To beg is to ask urgently or humbly; it can also mean to request money or food as charity.
beg 表示恳求、乞求；也可指乞讨。
type: A type is a category or kind; to type is to enter text using a keyboard.
type 作名词指类型、种类；作动词指打字、输入文本。
legal: Legal means permitted or required by law, or relating to the law.
legal 指合法的、法律允许的，也可指法律方面的。
inside: Inside means in or into the inner part of something, rather than outside it.
inside 表示在……里面、向内部；可作介词、副词、名词或形容词。
misery: Misery is extreme unhappiness, suffering, or distress.
misery 指痛苦、悲惨或极度不幸。
emperor: An emperor is a ruler of an empire, traditionally ranked above a king.
emperor 指皇帝、帝国统治者。
stretch: To stretch is to extend or pull something longer; a stretch is a continuous length or period.
stretch 指伸展、拉长；名词还可指一段距离或一段时间。
campaign: A campaign is an organized series of activities intended to achieve a goal.
campaign 指有组织的行动或活动，如竞选、宣传运动或军事战役。
jump: To jump is to push oneself into the air; it can also mean a sudden increase.
jump 指跳跃；作名词或动词也可表示突然上升。
sink: To sink is to move below the surface or descend; a sink is also a basin used for washing.
sink 作动词指下沉、沉没；作名词通常指水槽、洗涤池。
flame: A flame is the visible burning gas of a fire; it can also symbolize strong emotion.
flame 指火焰，也可比喻强烈情感。
weight: Weight is how heavy someone or something is; it can also mean importance or influence.
weight 指重量、体重；也可比喻分量、重要性或影响力。
favour: Favour is the British spelling of favor: kindness, approval, or special treatment.
favour 是英式拼写，对应美式 favor；可指帮助、好意、赞同或偏袒。
female: Female refers to the sex that can produce eggs; as a noun or adjective it can refer to females of a species.
female 指雌性、女性；用于人时常以 woman、girl 等更具体的词作名词。
league: A league is an association or grouping, especially of sports teams, or a level of ability.
league 指联盟、联赛；也可表示同一水平或等级。
physics: Physics is the science of matter, energy, motion, and their interactions.
physics 指物理学，研究物质、能量、运动及其相互作用。
pleased: Pleased means feeling happy or satisfied about something.
pleased 表示高兴的、满意的，常见结构为 pleased with / pleased to。
province: A province is a regional administrative division of a country.
province 指省、行政区，也可指一个人的职责或专业领域。
sin: A sin is an act considered morally or religiously wrong.
sin 指罪、罪孽；也可较宽泛地指不道德的行为。
neck: The neck connects the head to the body; it can also be the narrow part of an object.
neck 指脖子、颈部，也可指瓶口等物体较窄的部分。
hotel: A hotel is a commercial building that provides rooms and often other services to travelers.
hotel 指旅馆、酒店，通常为旅客提供住宿等服务。
labor: Labor is the American spelling of labour, meaning work, workers collectively, or childbirth.
labor 是美式拼写，对应英式 labour，可指劳动、劳动力，也可指分娩。
couple: A couple is two people or things considered together; a couple of often means approximately two.
couple 指一对、两人；a couple of 通常表示两个左右，有时泛指少量。
editor: An editor selects, revises, or prepares material for publication.
editor 指编辑，负责选稿、修订或出版内容。
insist: To insist is to state firmly that something is true or must happen.
insist 指坚持认为、坚决要求；常见结构为 insist on doing 和 insist that。
punish: To punish is to impose a penalty on someone for wrongdoing.
punish 指惩罚、处罚，常见结构为 punish somebody for something。
rising: Rising means moving upward or increasing; it may describe levels, prices, or a developing trend.
rising 表示上升的、增长的；常形容价格、水位或趋势。
development: Development is a process of growth or change; it can also mean a new event or advance.
development 指发展、开发、成长；也可指新进展或新情况。
wing: A wing is a part used for flight; it can also be a side section of a building or organization.
wing 指翅膀、机翼，也可指建筑侧翼或组织派别。
angry: Angry means feeling strong displeasure, usually because something seems unfair or wrong.
angry 指生气的、愤怒的，常见结构为 angry with somebody 或 angry about something。
haste: Haste is excessive speed or urgency, often with a risk of mistakes.
haste 指匆忙、急促；in haste 表示仓促地。
march: To march is to walk in measured steps, often in a group; a march is also a public procession.
march 指齐步行进、游行；首字母大写的 March 则指三月。
sword: A sword is a weapon with a long metal blade.
sword 指剑、刀剑，通常有长金属刃。
mighty: Mighty means very powerful, strong, or impressive.
mighty 表示强大的、有力的；非正式用法中也可加强程度。
european: European means relating to Europe or its people; a European is a person from Europe.
European 作形容词指欧洲的；作名词指欧洲人。
happiness: Happiness is a feeling of pleasure, satisfaction, or well-being.
happiness 指幸福、快乐或满足感。
sacrifice: A sacrifice is something given up for a greater purpose; to sacrifice means to give it up.
sacrifice 指牺牲、舍弃；既可指付出的代价，也可指主动放弃。
owe: To owe is to have an obligation to pay or give something, or to be indebted to someone.
owe 指欠钱、欠债，也可指因他人的帮助而怀有感激。
debt: A debt is money or another obligation that is owed.
debt 指债务、欠款；也可比喻人情债或感激之情。
tale: A tale is a story, often imaginative or traditional.
tale 指故事、传说，常带有叙事或想象色彩。
wine: Wine is an alcoholic drink typically made from fermented grapes.
wine 指葡萄酒，也可指类似方法制成的果酒。
palace: A palace is a grand residence, especially one belonging to royalty or a high official.
palace 指宫殿、王宫或宏伟的官邸。
central: Central means located near the middle or of greatest importance.
central 表示中央的、中心的，也可指关键的、核心的。
district: A district is an area defined for administration, services, or other purposes.
district 指地区、区域，常用于行政区、学区或商业区。
parliament: A parliament is a legislative body that debates and makes laws.
parliament 指议会、国会一类立法机构。
revolution: A revolution is a major change, especially in government, society, or technology.
revolution 指革命、剧变；在物理语境中也可指旋转一周。
mad: Mad can mean angry, mentally unwell, or extremely enthusiastic, depending on context and variety of English.
mad 可指生气的、疯狂的，口语中还可表示对某事非常着迷；各地英语的常见义不同。
hunt: To hunt is to pursue animals for capture or to search intensively for something.
hunt 指狩猎、捕猎，也可指搜寻、寻找。
hurt: To hurt is to cause pain or injury; hurt can also describe emotional distress.
hurt 指使疼痛、使受伤，也可表示感情受到伤害。
lock: A lock is a device that keeps something closed; to lock means to secure it.
lock 指锁；作动词时表示锁上、锁住，也可指使设备处于锁定状态。
sake: Sake means purpose or benefit, commonly in the expressions for the sake of and for ...'s sake.
sake 常用于 for the sake of（为了……的缘故）等结构，表示目的、利益或理由。
self: Self refers to a person's identity or essential character; it can also mean one's own person.
self 指自我、自身，也可指一个人的个性或本质。
tall: Tall describes someone or something having considerable height.
tall 表示高的，常用来形容人、树木或高而窄的建筑。
blind: Blind means unable to see; it can also mean unaware of something or refusing to consider it.
blind 指失明的、看不见的；引申可指没有察觉或盲目不顾。
image: An image is a picture or representation; it can also mean a mental picture or public impression.
image 指图像、影像，也可表示脑海中的印象或公众形象。
mercy: Mercy is compassion shown to someone who could be punished or harmed.
mercy 指仁慈、宽恕，尤其是对处于弱势或可能受罚的人表现出的怜悯。
sorry: Sorry means feeling regret, sympathy, or an apology, according to context.
sorry 表示抱歉、遗憾，也可表达同情。
stare: To stare is to look at someone or something for a long time with fixed attention.
stare 指凝视、盯着看，常暗示目光持续而直接。
bottom: The bottom is the lowest or deepest part of something.
bottom 指底部、最下方；也可指名单或排名的末位。
sister: A sister is a female sibling; it may also denote a close female member of a religious or social group.
sister 指姐妹、姊妹；也可指修女或团体中的女性成员。
sorrow: Sorrow is deep sadness, especially caused by loss or disappointment.
sorrow 指悲伤、哀痛，尤指因失去或失望而产生的痛苦。
weather: Weather is the condition of the atmosphere at a particular time and place.
weather 指天气、气象状况；注意与长期的 climate（气候）区别。
capital: Capital can mean a nation's seat of government, money or assets, or an uppercase letter.
capital 可指首都、资本，也可指大写字母；不同义项需按语境判断。
consume: To consume is to use up a resource or to eat and drink something.
consume 指消耗、耗费；也可指吃、喝等消费行为。
freedom: Freedom is the ability or right to act, speak, or choose without undue restriction.
freedom 指自由，即在适当范围内行动、表达或选择的权利或状态。
remains: Remains are what is left after something is gone, used up, or destroyed.
remains 指剩余物、遗迹、遗体等；与动词 remain 的第三人称单数形式同形。
triumph: A triumph is an important victory or success; to triumph is to achieve one.
triumph 指重大胜利、成功；作动词时表示获胜、取得成功。
darkness: Darkness is the absence of light; figuratively it can suggest fear or ignorance.
darkness 指黑暗、没有光线；比喻用法中可表示恐惧或无知。
opposite: Opposite means on the other side or completely different; an opposite is a contrasting counterpart.
opposite 表示对面的、相反的；作名词可指对立面或反义事物。
construct: To construct is to build or create something by putting parts or ideas together.
construct 指建造、构建；既可用于建筑，也可用于建立模型或论证。
entertain: To entertain is to amuse someone, receive guests, or consider an idea as a possibility.
entertain 可指娱乐、招待客人，也可指考虑某个想法或可能性。
legislate: To legislate is to make or enact laws through an official process.
bury: To bury is to place something under the ground, often a dead body; it can also mean to hide deeply.
bury 指埋葬、掩埋；引申可表示深深藏起。
coat: A coat is an outer garment; it can also mean a covering layer, such as a coat of paint.
coat 指外套、大衣；也可表示油漆等覆盖层。
port: A port is a harbor for ships; in computing, it can be a connection point for communication.
port 指港口；计算机语境中指端口、接口。
fifty: fifty 是基数词“五十”，其序数词为 fiftieth。
pride: Pride is satisfaction in an achievement or identity; it may also mean excessive self-regard.
pride 指自豪、自尊；在某些语境中也指傲慢、自负。
spite: Spite is a desire to hurt or annoy someone; in spite of means despite.
spite 指恶意、怨恨；常见短语 in spite of 表示“尽管”。
mortal: Mortal means subject to death; it can also describe something that can cause death.
mortal 表示会死的、凡人的；也可表示致命的。
pocket: A pocket is a small sewn pouch in clothing; figuratively it can be a small isolated area.
pocket 指衣袋、口袋；引申可指小块区域或局部聚集。
descend: To descend is to move downward or come from an ancestor.
descend 指下降、下行；也可表示世系上源自某位祖先。
inhabit: To inhabit is to live in or occupy a particular place.
inhabit 指居住于、栖息于，通常直接接地点宾语。
program: A program is a plan of activities or instructions for a computer; the spelling programme is also used in British English for some senses.
program 指计划、节目或计算机程序；英式英语中部分非计算机义项常写作 programme。
powerful: Powerful means having great physical strength, authority, or ability to produce an effect.
powerful 表示有力的、强大的；既可指力量、权力，也可指影响力。
disappear: To disappear is to become impossible to see or to cease to exist.
disappear 指消失、不见，也可指不复存在。
profession: A profession is an occupation that usually requires specialized training or qualifications.
profession 指职业，尤其是需要专门训练或资格的专业工作。
knee: The knee is the joint between the upper and lower parts of the leg.
thin: Thin means having little thickness or being relatively narrow; it may also mean not dense.
thin 表示薄的、细的、瘦的；也可指不浓稠或不密集。
spoken: Spoken is the past participle of speak and can describe language used in speech rather than writing.
spoken 是 speak 的过去分词，也可形容口头的、口语的。
yellow: Yellow is the color between green and orange in the visible spectrum.
yellow 指黄色；也可用作形容词描述黄颜色的事物。
finding: A finding is a conclusion or result reached through investigation or research.
finding 指研究发现、调查结果；findings 常表示多项研究发现。
director: A director is someone who leads an organization or directs a film, play, or project.
director 指负责人、主管，也可指导演。
division: Division is the act of separating into parts; it can also mean a department or a mathematical operation.
division 指划分、分割，也可指部门或数学中的除法。
presently: Presently can mean soon or, especially in some varieties of English, at the present time.
presently 可指“不久、马上”；部分英语变体中也表示“目前”，须留意语境。
remarkable: Remarkable means unusual, impressive, or worthy of attention.
remarkable 表示非凡的、引人注目的、值得注意的。
job: A job is paid work, a specific task, or something that must be done.
job 指工作、职位，也可指具体任务。
pour: To pour is to cause a liquid to flow in a steady stream; rain can also pour heavily.
pour 指倾倒、倒出液体；也可形容大雨倾盆而下。
birth: Birth is the act or process of being born; figuratively, it can mean the beginning of something.
birth 指出生、诞生；引申可表示某事物的开端。
owner: An owner is a person or organization that legally possesses something.
owner 指所有者、物主或业主。
weary: Weary means very tired, especially after prolonged effort or difficulty.
weary 指疲惫的、厌倦的，强调长期消耗后的疲劳感。
height: Height is the distance from the bottom to the top of something, or a person's stature.
height 指高度、身高，也可比喻某事的顶点。
behold: To behold is to see or look at something, usually in literary or formal language.
behold 指看见、注视，常见于文学或较正式的语体。
castle: A castle is a large fortified building, especially a historic residence of nobility.
castle 指城堡，通常指历史上具有防御功能的贵族建筑。
praise: To praise is to express approval or admiration; praise is also the expression itself.
praise 指赞扬、称赞；可作动词或名词。
temple: A temple is a building used for religious worship; in anatomy, the temple is the side of the head.
temple 指寺庙、神殿；解剖学中还可指太阳穴。
clothes: Clothes are items worn on the body, such as shirts, trousers, and coats.
clothes 指衣服、服装，通常作复数名词使用。
engaged: Engaged can mean busy or occupied, committed to marry, or involved in an activity.
engaged 可表示忙于某事、参与其中，也可指订婚。
accomplish: To accomplish is to complete a task or achieve a goal through effort.
accomplish 指完成任务、实现目标，强调努力后取得结果。
pair: A pair is two matching or associated things; to pair is to put two together.
pair 指一对、一双；作动词时表示配对、搭配。
stir: To stir is to move a spoon through a liquid or mixture; it can also awaken an emotion.
stir 指搅拌、搅动；也可指激起情绪或反应。
waste: To waste is to use something carelessly or without benefit; waste is also unwanted material.
waste 作动词指浪费；作名词可指废弃物或浪费。
golden: Golden means made of gold or having a color like gold; it can also mean exceptionally good.
golden 表示金制的、金色的；引申可表示难得的、极好的。
disturb: To disturb is to interrupt someone's rest or activity, or to upset a peaceful condition.
disturb 指打扰、扰乱，也可指使人不安。
southern: Southern means relating to or situated in the south.
southern 指南方的、位于南部的。
sentiment: Sentiment is a feeling, attitude, or opinion, often expressed emotionally.
sentiment 指情感、情绪或看法，有时强调感情色彩。
administration: Administration is the management of an organization or the government in charge during a period.
administration 指管理、行政事务，也可指某届政府或行政团队。
hill: A hill is an area of raised land, generally lower than a mountain.
hill 指小山、山丘，通常比 mountain 规模小。
inch: An inch is a unit of length equal to 2.54 centimeters.
inch 是英寸，等于 2.54 厘米。
sigh: To sigh is to breathe out audibly, often showing sadness, relief, or frustration.
sigh 指叹气、叹息，通常表达遗憾、宽慰或无奈。
west: West is the direction toward the sunset; it can also refer to a western region.
west 指西方、西部；可作名词、形容词或副词。
confuse: To confuse is to make someone unable to understand or distinguish something clearly.
confuse 指使人困惑、混淆；常见结构为 confuse A with B。
disease: A disease is a condition that impairs normal functioning of an organism, often producing characteristic symptoms.
disease 指疾病、病症，通常指影响身体或生理功能的病理状态。
kingdom: A kingdom is a country ruled by a king or queen; in biology it is a major classification category.
kingdom 指王国；生物分类中也指“界”。
species: A species is a group of living organisms classified as closely related and often capable of interbreeding.
species 指物种；单复数同形，例如 one species、many species。
necessity: Necessity is something essential or the state of being required.
necessity 指必要性、必需品；of necessity 有“必然地”的意思。
suffering: Suffering is the experience of physical pain or mental distress.
suffering 指痛苦、苦难，可以是身体上的，也可以是精神上的。
comfortable: Comfortable means feeling physically at ease or free from worry; it can also describe a reassuring environment.
comfortable 表示舒适的、自在的，也可形容使人放松的环境。
kid: Kid most often means a child; it can also refer to a young goat, and as a verb it means to joke or tease.
kid 通常指“小孩”，也指“小山羊”；作动词时表示开玩笑或戏弄。
guy: Guy is an informal word for a man or person; guys can address a mixed group in casual speech.
guy 是非正式的“男人、家伙”；guys 在口语中也可用来称呼一群人，不限男性。
teacher: A teacher helps people learn in a school or another setting; teacher is broader than professor.
teacher 指在学校或其他场合教授知识的人，范围比“大学教授”更广。
someone: Someone means an unspecified person; it is normally singular in grammar even when the person's identity is unknown.
someone 指“某人、有人”，身份不确定，但语法上通常视作单数。
drug: A drug is a substance used as medicine or one that changes the mind or body; the context determines whether it means a medication or an illicit drug.
drug 可指用于治疗的药物，也可指影响身心的毒品；具体含义取决于语境。
international: International describes something involving more than one country or relations between countries.
international 表示涉及多个国家或国家之间关系的“国际的”。
phone: A phone is a device for speaking or communicating at a distance; to phone someone means to call them.
phone 作名词是“电话、手机”，作动词表示“打电话给某人”。
doctor: A doctor may be a medical practitioner or someone holding a doctoral degree; the title alone does not always imply medical training.
doctor 可以指“医生”，也可以指拥有博士学位的人；仅凭头衔不一定能判断其是否行医。
worker: A worker is someone who does work, especially as an employee; the word does not always mean a manual laborer.
worker 指从事工作的人，特别是雇员；并不总是特指体力劳动者。
movie: A movie is a film, especially one made for entertainment or storytelling.
movie 通常指作为娱乐或叙事作品的“电影”，与 film 在这一义项上基本同义。
technology: Technology means practical methods, tools, and systems developed using knowledge, often scientific knowledge.
technology 指运用知识（常包括科学知识）形成的技术、工具及系统，不只指电子设备。
baby: A baby is a very young child or animal; baby can also describe something in its earliest stage.
baby 主要指“婴儿、幼崽”，也可比喻某事物处于初始阶段。
computer: A computer is an electronic device that processes data according to instructions.
computer 指按照指令处理数据的电子设备，即“计算机、电脑”。
film: Film can mean a movie, a thin coating or layer, or the material once used to record photographs; to film is to record moving images.
film 可指“电影、薄膜、胶片”；作动词是“拍摄影像”。
organization: An organization is a group arranged to pursue a purpose; organization also means the way parts are ordered and managed.
organization 可指为共同目标而建立的“组织、机构”，也指“组织方式、条理”。
energy: Energy is the capacity to do work in physics; in daily speech it also means vitality or enthusiasm.
energy 在物理学中指“能量”，日常英语中也指“精力、活力”。
medical: Medical describes matters involving medicine, health care, or the treatment of illness.
medical 表示与医学、医疗或疾病治疗相关的“医学的、医疗的”。
hospital: A hospital provides medical treatment, often including inpatient care; not every clinic is a hospital.
hospital 是提供医疗服务、通常具备住院条件的“医院”，与一般诊所不同。
defense: Defense means protection against attack, criticism, or harm; it can also mean the arguments offered in support of a position.
defense 指对攻击、批评或伤害的“防御、保护”，也可指为某种立场提出的辩护理由。
agency: An agency may be a business that provides services for others or a government body carrying out particular duties.
agency 可指代理服务机构，也可指承担特定职责的政府机关。
page: A page is one side of a sheet in a book or document; it can also be a screen of content on a website.
page 是书籍或文件中的“一页”，也指网页等显示的一页内容。
decade: A decade is a period of ten years; the 1990s are the decade from 1990 through 1999.
decade 指“十年”；例如 1990s 指 1990 至 1999 年这十年。
career: A career is a person's long-term working life or professional development, not just one job.
career 指较长期的职业生涯或职业发展，而不只是某一份工作。
treatment: Treatment means the way someone or something is handled; in medicine it means care intended to improve a condition.
treatment 指“对待、处理”的方式；在医学语境中指“治疗、疗法”。
pressure: Pressure can mean force per unit area in physics, or the psychological demand to act or succeed.
pressure 在物理学中指单位面积上的“压强”，日常还指心理或社会上的“压力”。
staff: Staff refers collectively to employees of an organization; it normally names a group rather than a single worker.
staff 通常指一个机构的“全体职员、工作人员”，是集合称呼。
training: Training is a process of learning and practicing skills for a task, profession, or activity.
training 指为掌握某项工作、职业或活动所需技能而进行的“训练、培训”。
physical: Physical can mean related to the body, material things, or physics; physical activity specifically means bodily movement.
physical 可表示“身体的、物质的、物理学的”；physical activity 特指身体活动。
lawyer: A lawyer is a qualified legal professional who gives legal advice or represents clients.
lawyer 指提供法律咨询或代理当事人的“律师、法律专业人员”。
section: A section is a distinct part of a larger whole, such as a document, organization, or area.
section 指整体中划分出来的一“部分、章节、部门或区域”。
environmental: Environmental describes the natural environment or the conditions surrounding an organism or activity.
environmental 表示与自然环境或周围条件有关的“环境的、环保的”。
skill: A skill is an ability developed through learning, experience, or practice.
skill 指通过学习、经验或练习获得的“技能、技巧”。
financial: Financial relates to money, the management of funds, or financial markets.
financial 表示与资金、财务管理或金融市场有关的“财务的、金融的”。
clearly: Clearly can mean in an easily understood manner or obviously, without doubt.
clearly 可以表示“清楚地”，也可以表示“显然、毫无疑问地”。
executive: An executive is a senior manager; executive can also describe authority to put decisions into effect.
executive 作名词可指高级管理人员；作形容词可表示“执行的、行政的”。
manager: A manager is a person responsible for directing people, projects, or operations.
manager 是负责管理人员、项目或业务运营的“经理、管理者”。
network: A network is a system of connected people or things; in computing, it is a system of interconnected devices.
network 指相互连接的人或事物构成的“网络”，计算机语境中指互联设备的网络。
nice: Nice usually means pleasant, kind, or enjoyable; in some contexts it can mean subtle or precise.
nice 通常表示“令人愉快的、友善的、不错的”，在较正式的语境中也可指“细微的、精确的”。
expert: An expert has extensive knowledge or skill in a particular field; it can be a noun or adjective.
expert 可作名词“专家”，也可作形容词“熟练的、专业的”。
radio: Radio refers to wireless broadcasting or the device receiving it; it can also describe radio-frequency communication.
radio 指“广播、收音机”，也可指无线电通信技术。
management: Management is the activity of organizing and directing resources or people; it can also refer to the managers collectively.
management 指“管理工作、经营管理”，也可集合指“管理层”。
tonight: Tonight means this evening or the night of the present day; it is used as a noun or an adverb.
tonight 表示“今晚、今夜”，既可作名词，也可作副词。
huge: Huge means extremely large in size, number, or degree.
huge 表示大小、数量或程度“极大的、巨大的”。
traditional: Traditional describes customs or practices passed down over time or following an established pattern.
traditional 表示沿袭传统或既有做法的“传统的、惯常的”。
employee: An employee works for an employer in return for pay; an employer is the person or organization hiring them.
employee 是受雇并获得报酬的“员工”；与雇用他们的 employer 相对。
cultural: Cultural relates to a society's ideas, art, values, and ways of life.
cultural 表示与社会文化、艺术、价值观或生活方式有关的“文化的”。
interview: An interview is a structured conversation for assessing a candidate or obtaining information; to interview is to conduct one.
interview 是为面试或获取信息而进行的“访谈、面谈”，也可作动词“采访、面试”。
camera: A camera is a device that captures photographs or video.
camera 指拍摄照片或视频的“照相机、摄像机”。
production: Production is the process of making goods, works, or other outputs; it may also refer to the amount produced.
production 指“生产、制作”的过程，也可指“产量、制成品”。
trip: A trip is a journey, often a relatively short one; to trip is to stumble or cause someone to stumble.
trip 作名词常指“旅行、短途行程”；作动词可指“绊倒、失足”。
conference: A conference is a formal meeting where participants exchange ideas or discuss a topic.
conference 指与会者就某主题交流、讨论的正式“会议、研讨会”。
unit: A unit is a single element of a larger system, a standard quantity, or a military/organizational group.
unit 可指“单元、单位（计量）、部队或组织中的分队”。
institution: An institution is an established organization, such as a university or bank; it can also mean an established social practice.
institution 指大学、银行等“机构”，也可指社会中长期形成的“制度、惯例”。
stuff: Stuff is an informal word for things or material whose exact identity is unspecified; to stuff means to pack tightly.
stuff 作名词是非正式的“东西、材料”，作动词表示“塞满、填充”。
bag: A bag is a flexible container used to carry things; to bag something can mean to put it in a bag.
bag 指携带物品的“袋子”；作动词可指“装袋”。
